purpose: Verified lifecycle contract for managing property evidence retrieval and validation as a traceable session.
core_principle: REQUEST → RETRIEVE → IDENTIFY → MATCH → EXTRACT → CHECK CONFLICT → REASSESS SUFFICIENCY → CLOSE OR CONTINUE
critical_distinctions: retrieval success is not evidence sufficiency
retrieval failure is not proof of record absence
access restriction is not record absence
user document is not automatically official evidence
current record is not automatically historical proof
closure_rule: Close only with an explicit verified, limited, partial, indeterminate, access-limited or source-unavailable state.
audit_rule: Every material retrieval attempt and validation transition must remain traceable.
verification_boundary: This manager records and governs retrieval workflow; it does not itself establish the truth of a retrieved record.
